title: Pixel Art Character Ideas: Original Prompts for Pixel OCs
summary: Original pixel OC prompts and a 10-minute workshop. No fandom copies—just sparks for avatars, sprites, and casts.
body_markdown:
> **Quick answer:** Use short prompts that combine a role, a mood, and a visual hook—then build the pixel look. These ideas are for original characters, not fandom copies.


Return to the[pixel character maker hub](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/pixel-character-maker) when you are ready to pick a tool. Parent:[character creator app](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/character-creator-app) .


Table of Contents


Toggle


##


How to use these prompts


#


Pick one line. Add a name. Limit your palette. Draw or assemble. Write three traits.


##


Prompt packs


#


###


Soft everyday


#


- Bakery early-shift kid who talks to sourdough
- Library scout who rates rainy days
- Bike courier who collects lost buttons


###


Slightly strange


#


- Weather reporter for clouds that lie
- Mechanic for broken music boxes
- Night-market cart with a shy guardian


###


Adventurous (original worlds)


#


- Map-folder who refuses to mark "here be dragons"
- River guide for paper boats
- Rooftop gardener of glowing herbs


###


Cast seeds (make 3 together)


#


- The planner, the wildcard, the tired adult
- Twin inventors who share one notebook
- A band where only the drummer can see ghosts


##


Turn an idea into a living OC


#


- One visual hook
- One want
- One fear
- One relationship
- Put them somewhere they can act


That last step is where Redbean fits: original characters in a pixel world, not only a PNG.


##


More prompt packs


#


###


Soft sci-fi (original)


#


- Courier of unlabeled packages on a quiet moon
- Botanist raising plants that hum lullabies
- Archivist of broken satellite jokes


###


Soft fantasy (original)


#


- Baker of bread that remembers dreams
- Ferryperson for shy river spirits
- Cartographer who draws feelings as hills


###


Slice-of-life pixel


#


- Night-shift florist
- Arcade technician who talks to cabinets
- Raincoat kid collecting puddle reflections


##


Mini workshop (10 minutes)


#


- Timer for two minutes: list 10 silly jobs.
- Circle three.
- Add a visual hook to each.
- Pick one and lock a 6-color palette.
- Assemble or sketch for five minutes.
- Write three traits before you refine art.


##


Sharing tips


#


When you post an OC, lead with name + one hook + unofficial/original note. Invite questions about personality, not only "what brush."


##


Keep notes outside the app


#


Whatever tool you try, keep a short external note with the character or pet name, the goal for this week, and three facts that must not drift. Apps change. Your notes travel.

##


Dialogue sparks (one line each)


#


- "I only map places I have already forgiven."
- "The sourdough listens better than people."
- "If the vending machine knows my name, I am staying."


Use a line as the seed; build the pixel look to match the voice.


##


Weekly OC challenge (optional)


#


Mon: job prompt. Tue: palette. Wed: silhouette. Thu: traits. Fri: one scene sketch in words. Sat: revise. Sun: rest or share.
